content:
maria_p: Heads up — ACME Cloud is asking to list one of our open-model partners in their marketplace and co-announce with an HW partner (EdgeCore). They want clarity on redistribution, geoblocking, and who can rehost quantized weights. @dave_legal can you weigh in?

ben_pm: timeline: ACME wants marketplace listing + press in ~3 weeks. EdgeCore asked for a joint blog + demo at their May partner summit.

dave_legal: Need to know the upstream license (e.g., Apache 2.0, MIT, CC-BY) and any downstream addenda supplier requires. Two quick flags: export-control (EAR/ITAR) and source provenance (we should require PoR or attestations).

sara_ops: For Private deployments we need to check whether partner allows on-prem binaries vs container images. If they forbid rehosting of quantized artifacts that impacts our Dedicated offering.

tony_eng: From infra side: if they're okay with redistributing quantized weights we need a signed checksum and a small compatibility matrix for our runtime (fp16/q4_*). Also want to confirm whether EdgeCore needs a separate optimized build or just the baseline weights.

dave_legal: Draft clause suggestion (very short):
```
Partner grants Redwood a non-exclusive right to distribute model artifacts to Redwood customers under the partner's upstream license; redistribution outside Redwood's managed offerings requires prior written consent. Export-controlled outputs remain subject to applicable law. Partner must provide provenance attestations for training data and third-party components.
```

maria_p: This looks good as a starting point. Two product questions: 1) Do we allow the marketplace SKU to include the quantized weights (so customers can pull a bundle), or only let us host inference behind Redwood API? 2) Do we need to geo-block downloads for certain countries?

sara_ops: Ops prefers hosting (no direct downloads) unless partner signs an explicit redistribution addendum. Hosting reduces support surface and keeps telemetry for perf SLOs. Geo-blocking: yes for a short list of embargoed countries — we can enforce per-SKU region policies.

dave_legal: Recommend default: hosting-only on marketplace SKU. If partner signs redistribution addendum (we can template), then allow packaged downloads with additional indemnities. Geo-block list — provide legal with target countries and we'll bake into the contract.

ben_pm: Action items: 
- @dave_legal: push a redistribution addendum template (due EOD Friday)
- @maria_p: ask partner for upstream license and provenance docs (due Tuesday)
- @tony_eng/@sara_ops: quick compatibility checklist for quantized variants (due Wed)

maria_p: copying EdgeCore contact (cc'd in email). I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs 9am PT to finalize; tentative agenda: legal addendum, hosting vs download, announcement cadence.

tony_eng: FYI — if we publish a marketplace bundle that includes an optimized EdgeCore artifact we may need to sign an OSS attribution notice. I'll add that to checklist. :memo:

dave_legal: Quick note on announcements: keep wording neutral — "available through Redwood on ACME Cloud marketplace" and avoid implying exclusive performance claims unless we have benchmark sign-off.

announce-bot: [scheduled] marketplace-listing-proposal created for 2025-05-12 16:00 UTC — reminder set for participants.

maria_p: Great. I'll post the partner ask + provenance checklist in this thread once I get the docs. Thanks all :rocket:
